name: Aihara Takuya
source: Aihara Takuya seems like a normal, unimpressive guy. But in truth, he is one of the most peculiar high school students out there. His uncanny ability to get into the most unimaginable troubles is an ever-puzzling dilemma that nobody can really solve. Now it looks like he is on a path to repeat one of his most bizarre adventures every year. You'd believe that [url=https://vndb.org/c34009]once[/url] was already enough but for Takuya, it seems like he didn't really get a hint the first time. Becoming the president of the club that initially had put you into very serious trouble and then even exposing yourself as a guinea pig to random dubious experiments is the very last thing anybody with a sane mind would have thought of doing. But not Takuya, he is somewhat special and this year, he will show us how [url=https://vndb.org/c63690]it is done[/url] again.
